title: nan
authors: Yang Z.; Li J.; Wu H.; Zlatanova S.; Wang W.; Fox J.; Yang B.; Tang Y.; Zhang R.; Gong J.; Wang X.; Wang J.; Wang Y.; Sun S.
key_contribution: Presents a visual geo-localization method matching camera images against prior maps constructed by handheld LiDAR SLAM and terrestrial point clouds.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
